access_detail: The current-version ZIP of 2026-11-05 held no tables; the all-versions ZIP (2026-11-04 extract, Last-Modified 2026-11-04 12:21 GMT) was read for the current version of each report. Alaska: 46 current reports from 3 permits, starts 2023-06-05 to 2026-10-26: AK0022551 (Anchorage) 43, AK0021440 (Ketchikan, two anticipated pump-station bypasses) 2, AK0053775 (Denali National Park, a federal facility) 1. 44 SSO, 2 bypass. name: 18 AAC 72.940 Emergency notice (wastewater)
access_detail: Read on akleg.gov 2026-11-07 (Justia and LII had refused). (a) The owner or operator of a domestic or nondomestic wastewater collection, treatment, or disposal system 'shall report to the department within 24 hours, or as soon after that as possible' for six kinds of event, among them a spill or other event that 'threatens public health or water quality', 'a sludge carry-over, washout, or overflow' and a by-pass of any part of the treatment works; (b) a written report to the department within seven days; (c) not for an onsite system serving a private residence.
status_reason: Regulator notice for wastewater emergencies (24 hours, written report in 7 days); no public-notice duty.

name: APDES individual permits (Juneau-Douglas AK0023213, Anchorage Asplund AK0022551) and DEC Water Permit Search
access_detail: DEC's permit search and wastewater pages answer 403 (DataDome) to scripted reads on 2026-11-07. Read instead on the City and Borough of Juneau's site: AK0023213 (EPA-issued 2001, expired 2006, administratively continued) Part I.D.1.g 'The permittee must ensure that the public receives adequate notification of CSO occurrences and CSO impacts' and Part III.H.2.a (public notification of overflows that may imminently and substantially endanger human health); AK0022951 (APDES, 2014) Appendix A Part 3.4 Twenty-four Hour Reporting: orally within 24 hours, in writing within five days, to DEC.
status_reason: Juneau's CSO and overflow public-notice clauses read; the APDES standard conditions read in one permit; the other permits not read.
